dedupe_keys.name: officegraph knowledge graph of iot measurements in a seven storey office building

description: OfficeGraph is a real-world knowledge graph of measurements from 444 Internet-of-Things devices, of 17 sensor models, taken over 11 months in a seven-storey office building, about 90 million RDF triples in all. It was built by Roderick van der Weerdt, Victor de Boer, Ronald Siebes and Frank van Harmelen of the Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam with Ronnie Groenewold of VolkerWessels iCity, archived on Zenodo on 1 December 2023 and described in an ESWC 2024 resource paper. Each device has its own file of measurements; enrichments add which devices sit in which rooms and floors, links from measurement dates to Wikidata, and graph-learning properties for the seventh-floor devices. Coverage is one office building; a 2025 RiverBench version by Adam Skaskiewicz, which splits the measurements into 15 million time-ordered graphs, calls it a Dutch building. Access: Zenodo (OfficeGraph.zip 173 MB and raw_data.7z 142 MB; benchmark 438 MB). Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: the building is not named in the record, and the data end after the 11-month collection. Simulation uses: testing building digital twins, occupancy and comfort analytics, and machine learning on building sensor graphs. Related records: the D^2EPC SmartHouse digital twin and the Vienna office occupant dataset.
